vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Hello, puzzle friends! Today's game is: find the different shape!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I love puzzles! I'm super fast!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look at the shapes. One is different. When the clock ticks, you think!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ready? Let's go!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle one! Which shape is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: That one! The circle!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oops! Silly me!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: It's the square! It has four corners. The others are round circles!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Say it with me: square!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle two! Which one is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This triangle! Easy!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Hmm, not quite!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: It's the circle! The triangles all have three points.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Say it: circle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle three! Find the different shape.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The heart! All the others are stars!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Say it: heart!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle four! Look closely!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: The long rectangle! The others are squares.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Say it: rectangle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle five! Which one is different now?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The blue heart! It's a different color!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Well done, Leo!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle six! Which one is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The big one!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oh wait! They are all big!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The little circle! It's the smallest one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: You are so good at puzzles! Time to stretch! Arms up high!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle! Now sit down. Ready!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle seven! Find the different shape.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The circle! The others are ovals, like eggs!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Say it: oval!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle eight! Which one is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: The star! The others are moons!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle nine! This one is tricky. Count the sides!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: This one has five sides. The others have six!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle ten! Which toy has a different shape?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The gift box! It's a square. The others are round!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now draw a big circle in the air, with your finger! Round, and round!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle eleven! Which one is different?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: That triangle is upside down!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And now... the super puzzle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Every shape has a twin, except one. Which shape is all alone?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Is it... the star?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Good try, Leo! Look again. The star has a twin!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The diamond! It has no twin!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Twelve puzzles! You did it! You are a shape superstar!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One more game! Shape riddles!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Which shape has three points?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A triangle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Which shape is round, like a ball?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: A circle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Which shape do we draw, to say I love you?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A heart!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's say all our shapes!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Circle!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Square!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Triangle!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Star!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Heart!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Your turn! Circle, square, triangle, star, heart!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Bye-bye, puzzle friends!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: See you next time!
